items.title: Bosshogg Macaroni is live! Keep a full schedule

chunks.text: Name where you want to arrive, then work backward. The customers, the sales, the years, or the credential are the steps, not a mood. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=20

There is always something you can do. Throwing your hands up is not a plan. If you cannot see the move, look at a smaller one that still changes the day. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=89
Taking care of home can be a byproduct of the work. Use the skill to attract a larger collaboration, not only to cover this week. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=116

Pair skills on purpose. A writer, a builder, a product person, and someone who can tell the story can each earn their keep. You can see when a seat is empty. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=131
You are not meant to do every job. You are meant to do enough of the work that you can hold what you have gathered. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=165
Aim past survival. Enough to get through the month is not the same as enough to thrive. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=174
Keep a full schedule of what you are responsible for. A wish list is not a schedule until the hours exist. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=180

A full schedule is hard when you do not know the required list. Start with what you are actually responsible for, not only the household errands. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=207
Do not skip the small tool or the small lesson because the price looks minor. The thing you almost pass on is often what keeps you in the work. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=480
If the room is not yours, do not stay and perform in it. Leaving a page that is not for you is cleaner than pretending. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=1920
The standard you grew up seeing is not the only standard. You can learn what was normal around you, then choose a higher one. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=2880
A place had a name and a way of doing things before you arrived. Learn that, then add your part. Do not pretend you started the street. Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SLVtSjXZ7UM&t=3360
